name: QuickSilk
description_en:
QuickSilk is a managed SaaS website builder and CMS aimed at marketing and communications teams, including nonprofit and government organizations. Its published feature set combines visual authoring with blogs, forms, events, member content, microsites, permissions and external integrations. The vendor operates hosting and updates; the feature page explicitly says customers do not receive source-code access.

Evaluate a representative editorial workflow and the actual service contract. Pricing is an individually tailored annual subscription with no public amount, and broad security/compliance claims on the marketing pages do not substitute for current scoped reports or tests of the proposed deployment.
description_zh:
QuickSilk 是面向营销和传播团队，包括非营利及政府机构的托管 SaaS 建站器与 CMS。公开功能将可视化创作与博客、表单、活动、会员内容、微站、权限和外部集成结合，厂商维护托管和更新，功能页明确客户不获得源码访问。

应评估代表性编辑流程和实际服务合同。价格为按客户定制的年度订阅，没有公开金额，营销页宽泛安全/合规描述不能替代当前明确范围的报告或目标部署测试。

core_features.explanation_en: Drag/drop modules, global structures and device-based visibility support site editing; microsites can have separate administration rights.
core_features.explanation_zh: 拖放模块、全局结构和设备可见性支持编辑，微站可有独立管理权限。

core_features.explanation_en: Forms can have required fields, CAPTCHA, internal/thank-you emails and CSV/Excel submission export.
core_features.explanation_zh: 表单可设必填、CAPTCHA、内部/感谢邮件，并将提交导出为 CSV/Excel。

core_features.explanation_en: The feature page lists module-level, role, group and department access controls; actual enforcement needs a scoped test.
core_features.explanation_zh: 功能页列模块、角色、组和部门访问控制，实际执行需针对范围测试。

pricing.summary_en: Customer-tailored annual subscription; no numeric price or unit published. Nonprofit/government inquiry options, no confirmed discount. Implementation/hosting/integration/third-party scope needs a written quote; trial duration unknown.
pricing.summary_zh: 按客户定制年度订阅，未发布金额或单位。非营利/政府可询价，未确认折扣。实施/托管/集成/第三方范围需书面报价，试用期限未知。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_zh: 演示一个完整编辑周期
sections.en: Ask for a trial/demo that uses a service page, a dated blog entry and a form with a real notification destination. The feature page describes templates/global elements, WYSIWYG authoring, module placement and device-specific content visibility. Check that an editor can update content without changing the global design, a reviewer can inspect it, and the live desktop/mobile result matches the intended audience. The public pages do not provide a complete versioned account walkthrough, so this is an evaluation sequence, not a verified set of UI clicks. The no-card free-trial offer has no duration or continuing-free entitlement established here.
sections.zh: 可要求试用/演示服务页面、带日期博客及有真实通知目的地的表单。功能页描述模板/全局元素、WYSIWYG 创作、模块放置和设备内容可见性，应检查编辑者能改内容而不改变全局设计、审阅者可检查，以及公开桌面/手机结果符合受众。公开页面没有完整版本化账户教程，因此这是评估顺序，不是验证过的界面点击。免卡试用未在这些来源确立期限或持续免费权利。

sections.title_en: Separate editor permissions from visitor membership
sections.title_zh: 区分编辑权限与访客会员身份
sections.en: QuickSilk advertises role/group/department controls down to modules. Separately, its membership tools cover registration, fees/donations, plans and hidden pages/sites; device/geographic conditions are another kind of visibility rule. Test the intended combinations: an author in one department should not edit another department’s module, and a nonmember should not receive protected content. A hidden page or design-level condition should not be assumed to enforce backend authorization. For multi-site work, specify whether templates, memberships, forms and admin rights are shared or isolated. None of those permission checks was executed here.
sections.zh: QuickSilk 宣传角色/组/部门控制细至模块；会员工具另覆盖注册、费用/捐赠、计划及隐藏页面/站点，设备/地理条件则是另一类可见性规则。应测试预期组合，例如一个部门作者不能编辑另一部门模块，非会员不能取得受保护内容。隐藏页面或设计层条件不能假定执行后端授权。多站场景需明确模板、会员、表单和管理权是共享还是隔离，本次未执行这些权限检查。

sections.title_en: Verify forms, CRM and content channels independently
sections.title_zh: 分别验证表单、CRM 与内容渠道
sections.en: The documented form scope includes required fields, CAPTCHA, optional acknowledgment, internal email and submission export to CSV/Excel. For a lead workflow, check stored data, notification delivery, failed-send handling and CRM field mapping separately. The integrations page describes Shutterstock image access and HubSpot as a beta integration; it does not establish current connector versions or zero third-party fees. The feature list also mentions OpenAPI/SDK and custom REST integrations, so ask for the actual API contract, credentials/permission model and retry/rate limits before planning synchronization. Commerce and event-calendar features do not prove full external payment/registration execution.
sections.zh: 表单文档列必填、CAPTCHA、可选确认、内部邮件和 CSV/Excel 导出。获客流程应分别检查存储数据、通知投递、失败处理及 CRM 字段映射。集成页描述 Shutterstock 图片访问，并将 HubSpot 称为 beta 集成，未确立当前版本或第三方免费。功能表另提 OpenAPI/SDK 和自定义 REST 集成，规划同步前应取得实际 API 契约、凭据/权限模型及重试/速率限制。电商和活动日历功能不证明外部支付/报名已执行。

sections.title_en: Obtain an annual scope and service quote
sections.title_zh: 取得年度范围及服务报价
sections.en: The dedicated pricing page explicitly tailors annual subscription pricing to each customer; no numeric price, seat unit or fixed tier is shown. It offers nonprofit special pricing and government preferred pricing as inquiry categories, not a guaranteed percentage. Request a quote for websites/microsites, users, storage/traffic, forms/member records, implementation, integrations, domains/email and support/SLA. The homepage says support and automatic upgrades are included, but that marketing statement does not establish every custom service is included in a particular contract. Public terms leave product/service refunds to their specific agreements and exclude domain purchase/transfer/renewal refunds.
sections.zh: 专门价格页明确按每位客户定制年度订阅，没有金额、席位单位或固定档。非营利特殊价和政府优选价是询价选项，不是保证折扣比例。报价应覆盖网站/微站、用户、存储/流量、表单/会员记录、实施、集成、域名/邮件及支持/SLA。首页说包含支持和自动升级，但不证明具体合同涵盖每项定制服务。公开条款将产品/服务退款留给各自协议，并排除域名购买/转移/续费退款。

sections.title_en: Treat security and portability as contract-specific questions
sections.title_zh: 按合同核实安全及可迁移性
sections.en: The feature page describes managed hosting, daily backups, instant updates and no source-code access. It includes references such as SAS70/SSAE16, Safe Harbor and Google+, without supplying a current dated audit scope for the proposed service. Do not convert those labels or “most secure” wording into verified present-day compliance or resilience. Request actual data location, backup/restore targets, patch responsibilities, incident/support terms and export/termination procedures. Terms distinguish customer data ownership from platform material rights; owning content does not itself provide runnable site export. This can fit a team wanting a managed CMS, while independent source deployment needs further evidence. No security audit, restore, API, membership, payment or migration was tested.
sections.zh: 功能页描述托管、每日备份、即时更新和无源码访问，同时使用 SAS70/SSAE16、Safe Harbor、Google+ 等名称，未提供目标服务当前带日期的审计范围。不能将这些标签或“最安全”文案转为已验证的当前合规/恢复能力。应取得实际数据地域、备份恢复目标、补丁责任、事故/支持条款及导出/终止流程。条款区分客户数据所有权与平台素材权利，拥有内容本身不提供可运行网站导出。希望托管 CMS 的团队可考虑它，独立源码部署仍需证据。本次未执行安全审计、恢复、API、会员、支付或迁移。

research_gaps.en: Current security/audit scope, data geography, quotas, SLA, restore/export and cancellation/retention terms require contract-specific evidence.
research_gaps.zh: 当前安全/审计范围、数据地域、配额、SLA、恢复/导出及取消/保留条款需具体合同证据。

research_gaps.en: No account, author/reviewer/member permissions, forms/CRM, API, commerce, backup or migration behavior was tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试账户、作者/审阅者/会员权限、表单/CRM、API、电商、备份或迁移。
